description: Make a QR code as SVG or PNG for a link, plain text, Wi-Fi login, contact card (vCard 3.0), email, SMS, phone call or map location. Same encoder as the website (qrcode.js: versions 1-40, error correction L/M/Q/H, smallest version that fits, best mask), UTF-8 so Arabic/emoji work. Options: size in px, quiet-zone margin, colours, square/rounded/dots modules, and an optional centre logo (forces level H). Returns the file path, the exact encoded text, version, module count and contrast warnings. Max about 2.9 KB of data at level L. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/qr-studio/

ecc.description: Error correction: L 7%, M 15% (default), Q 25%, H 30%. A logo forces H.

logo.description: Optional centre logo image (path or base64, max 5 MB). Covers ~22% of the code; error correction becomes H.

margin.description: Quiet zone in modules (default 4; under 2 may not scan).

mode.description: Encoding mode. "byte" (UTF-8, what the website uses), "auto" (numeric/alphanumeric when the text allows, smaller codes), or force one.

output.description: Where to write the result: a file path, or a folder ending in "/". Default: the server output folder (a temp folder unless --out-dir is set).

returnBase64.description: Also return the output as base64 in the result (only for small files). Default false.

security.description: wifi: WPA (WPA/WPA2/WPA3, default), WEP, or nopass (open).

shape.description: Module shape. Rounded/dots also round the three finder squares.

text.description: text: any text (encoded exactly as given).

type.description: What the code holds. Default: "url" if url is given, else "text".

url.description: url: web address; "https://" is added when no scheme is given.

version.description: QR version 1-40 (size), or 0 = smallest that fits (default).

name: qr_generate
title: QR code generator
